reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Binance-attributed PLUME trading tournament with stated reward, registration, promotion-period, and minimum-volume terms. The trading-interface demonstration explains how the tournament condition operates, and the available video evidence does not establish that the linked destinations or separately disclosed commissions are deceptive or connected to the stated reward mechanism.

citations.quote: Binance has launched the Plume (PLUME) Trading Tournament, giving users a chance to share a massive 20,000,000 PLUME token reward pool!
Register by clicking “Join Now” ✅ Trade at least $500 in: PLUME/USDT PLUME/USDC
Your ranking depends on your total trading volume!

opening.argument: The central message links a substantial PLUME reward to concrete actions that move viewers into trading: the viewer is told to register through “Join Now” and trade at least $500 in specified pairs. This is therefore a solicitation involving both account participation and cryptocurrency trading, not simply a discussion of rewards. The title frames the result as earning from a 20,000,000 PLUME pool, while the rules make access conditional on meeting the trading threshold. Even if the tournament exists, the presentation asks viewers to undertake a financially consequential action in exchange for the possibility of receiving digital assets.

citations.quote: Earn from 20,000,000 PLUME Rewards!
Register by clicking “Join Now” ✅ Trade at least $500 in: PLUME/USDT PLUME/USDC

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls this an ordinary promotion, but its own cited terms confirm the reward-action linkage: viewers must register and trade a minimum amount to qualify. A ranking system also means the advertised headline reward is not an assured outcome for the participant. The interface demonstration does not establish that a viewer will receive tokens; it demonstrates how to enter the required trading activity.

citations.quote: Your ranking depends on your total trading volume!
Only verified users can join

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted conditions describe eligibility for a competition, not a guaranteed payout or a request to send money to an unknown recipient. The minimum volume is plainly stated, rankings determine allocation, and the material identifies the activity as trading on Binance. The opening therefore shows a conditional promotional contest, while its characterization as an inherently deceptive acquisition scheme goes beyond what the evidence establishes.

citations.quote: Rewards will be distributed by May 14, 2026
No wash trading or manipulation allowed 🚫

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: a very large digital-token pool, a minimum $500 trading requirement, urgent promotional language, and directions to external Telegram and exchange destinations. The description repeatedly calls this a “Big Opportunity” and says “Don’t miss this chance,” while also listing multiple affiliate links. That combination can make the reward appear like an easy earnings opportunity while encouraging viewers to open or use trading accounts. The disclaimer does not remove the practical solicitation: viewers are still directed toward registration, trading, and outside channels before any reward can be obtained.

citations.quote: Big Opportunity for Traders!
Don’t miss this chance to boost your crypto earnings with PLUME trading on Binance!
Join our Telegram👇 https://t.me/Mim_Crypto_Offical
Our Affiliate Links ==============

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the links “separately disclosed commissions” understates their significance in context. The same description that promotes the tournament directs viewers to Telegram, Binance, and several other exchanges, and the promotional language urges viewers not to miss the opportunity. A disclaimer that crypto is risky does not negate the linked reward solicitation or explain why viewers should trust every destination being promoted.

citations.quote: Join Binance👇 https://accounts.binance.info/register?ref=411135924
Join SuperEx Exchange 👇 https://app.superex.live/register?invitationCode=WY71L4TES
We appreciate your support and want to assure you that we remain committed to providing accurate and unbiased information

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These signals are not evidence of fraud by themselves. The description expressly says cryptocurrency is speculative and that viewers should do their own research, and it identifies affiliate links as potentially commission-bearing. The promotion also supplies concrete eligibility, ranking, distribution, and anti-manipulation terms. External links and urgency language may merit caution, but they do not show that the stated tournament or reward is fabricated.

citations.quote: Cryptocurrency and blockchain projects are highly speculative and involve substantial risk.
Some of the links in this video or in the video description may be affiliate links.

opening.argument: Although the material is presented as a Binance announcement and instructional walkthrough, its practical function is promotional: it tells viewers where to click, how much to trade, and how to buy and sell PLUME so they can pursue the advertised vouchers. The description also places a Telegram offer link and numerous exchange signup links alongside the tournament pitch. This is not neutral reporting about a market event; it is a participation funnel built around a promised digital-asset benefit. The educational disclaimer cannot change that the viewer is being steered toward registration and trading.

citations.quote: Click on it and go to the trade now button
now we will buy this volume Now click on Buy button and click on Sell button
অফার Link 👇👇👇 https://t.me/Mim_Crypto_Offical

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense relies on the apparent Binance branding and trading screens, but those establish presentation, not independent verification of the promised benefit. The spoken walkthrough goes beyond describing terms: it instructs viewers to reach the trading screen and buy and sell the volume. That action-oriented guidance, combined with the Telegram offer link, is consistent with promotion regardless of whether the page resembles an official announcement.

citations.quote: now we will buy this volume Now click on Buy button and click on Sell button
Join our Telegram👇 https://t.me/Mim_Crypto_Offical

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Instructional guidance is expected in a trading-tournament explainer and does not itself make the offer fraudulent. The visual evidence includes a Binance-branded announcement, and the terms explain the eligible pairs, minimum volume, ranking method, and voucher distribution. The presence of promotion is undisputed, but promotion of a conditional exchange program is not enough to establish a scam without evidence that the announcement, destination, or reward mechanism is deceptive.
